title: Nar Singh Pal v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Nar Singh Pal v. Union of India, (2000) 5 SCC 588
content.holding: Acceptance of retrenchment compensation does not estop an employee from asserting his fundamental rights; there is no estoppel against the Constitution.
content.relevance: Reaffirmed no estoppel against the Constitution.

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India (2000) 5 SCC 588; 2000 INSC 182; 2000 (2) SCR 1028; fundamental rights cannot be waived by accepting retrenchment compensation.
